test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Three successive discounts of 15%, 20% and 25% are given. What will be the net discount in percentage?
solution:
**Given**

Three successive discounts of 15%, 20% and 25% are given.

Formula Used: 

Effective discount when two discounts are offered,

⇒ a + b - (a × b)/100
